mostWorthwhile.text: Protecting a traceable record against transmission errors was worthwhile: it separated checking how a finding was made from receiving its message intact, without treating either as proof of truth.

leastWorthwhile.text: The local-observer passage felt somewhat predictable: the result restated the limited role already suggested by the inputs.

surprise.text: The scholarly-fiction item led to an evidence trail rather than another discussion of fictional sources; the contrast between appearance and inspectable records made sense afterward.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the distinction between reliable transmission, evidence and authority offered useful questions, though the compatible-choice menu made the actions fairly predictable.
